name: Dishwater Nell
text: Start of your turn: swap the lowest-tier unit in your shop for one of your tier. If it was 2+ tiers lower and this touches an Ooze, gain 1 gold. Only your first Nell pays.
golden_text: Start of your turn: swap the 2 lowest-tier units in your shop for ones of your tier. If one was 2+ tiers lower and this touches an Ooze, gain 2 gold. Only your first Nell pays.
